data.one_liner: A customizable Flutter slide-to-confirm button widget to reduce accidental triggers.
data.what_it_does: Provides a customizable slide-to-confirm button widget. It requires users to drag a thumb across a track to complete an action, helping prevent accidental taps on irreversible features.
use_when: You want to prevent accidental triggers on destructive or irreversible actions like deleting or paying.
You need a slide-to-confirm mechanism with circle or square shapes, gradients, and async loaders.
avoid_when: You just need a standard button or a generic touch interaction without a sliding mechanism.
strengths: Supports async loader states and completion controllers.
Highly customizable with shapes, colors, gradients, and haptic feedback.
weaknesses: Limited to sliding action button use cases.
Relies entirely on custom widget rendering rather than standard platform elements.
